title: An `IHDR` declaring a filter method the specification does not define
why: `IHDR` carries **two** method bytes and the sibling case only ever moves one of them, so an engine that validates `compression` and ignores `filter` passes the suite and then accepts a correctly hashed PNG declaring `filter: 1` — reaching a gate verdict where a conforming decoder refuses the header. Not to be confused with the per-scanline filter *type*, which is a byte on every row and of which five are legal; this is the method byte, of which one is.
